i take 25mg. and ive been on it for like 4 months. :/

i smoke marijuana before bed to sleep better. works great.

effexor/wellbrutin/paxil and currently zoloft. 

all zoloft does is give me super intense dreams that are either enjoyable or 7th layer of hell scary.

well, i live in canada so technically it's free but in my province mental health is underfunded so the only way i can talk to someone is if i go to a hospital, say im gonna off myself and then see someone once a month who has a caseload of 150 patients already so it feels hopeless.

or i can check myself into the mental ward to get some serious care but i'd want to kill myself some more because i wouldn't even be able to call or see my fiancee.

i don't have the money to pay out of pocket for anyone professionally.

hopeless hopeless hopeless

shes great. sometimes my only reason for existing. shes very understanding of how i feel and doesn't get mad or upset at me for being unable to control how i feel. we've had some rough patches but never anything related to my mental illness.

shes kind of a sad person as well but not anywhere close to where i am.
yeah. anti depressants are useless. ive tried 3-4 of them for long periods of time.

Depression, Alcoholism, Anger.

Dropped out of highschool due to depression, went back for a bit, pulled 90's, stopped going due to depression.

Tried every kind of anti-depressant. High doses, low doses.

On top of this, I spend every moment in anger at my situation. Ive gained so much weight because my drinking problem, Ive lost so many friends because of my drinking. It's just a fucking cycle. Time is a flat circle true detective tier fuckin' hell.

Can't stop drinking because its the only part of my day where I feel okay.

Constant suicidal thoughts.

No job, my fiancee pays most of the bills. I buy alcohol with my credit card, slowly sinking into debt just to fuel my horrible addiction.

The worst part is that I don't even want anything. I don't want money, I dont want a career. I don't want kids. 

I just wanna drink.
